module dff(
  input  clk,
  input  d,
  output reg q
);
  always @(posedge clk)
    q <= ~d;  // Changed: inverted d
endmodule

module dff(
  input  clk,
  input  d,
  output reg q
);
  always @(posedge clk)
    q <= 1'b0;  // Changed: assigned constant 0 instead of d
endmodule

module dff(
  input  clk,
  input  d,
  output reg q
);
  always @(posedge clk)
    q <= q;  // Changed: assigned q to itself instead of d
endmodule

module dff(
  input  clk,
  input  d,
  output reg q
);
  always @(posedge clk)
    q = d;  // Changed: blocking assignment instead of non-blocking
endmodule

module dff(
  input  clk,
  input  d,
  output reg q
);
  always @(posedge clk)
    q <= d & clk;  // Changed: ANDed d with clk
endmodule

module dff(
  input  clk,
  input  d,
  output reg q
);
  always @(posedge clk)
    q <= d | q;  // Changed: ORed d with q
endmodule
